source_manifest_reference: Read-only Git inventory of six 2026-08-28 commits: 79 unique changed paths; earlier frozen manifest dispositions AG28-A225E298, AG28-CB0E5689 and AG28-976B9EE4 are superseded by this atomic review

items.source_item: Decision tiers, customer fast-track, KPI and process-strength changes
items.intent: Scale autonomy and urgent delivery while protecting accountable decisions
items.rationale: Triton's adaptive harness, decision rights, lean assurance, evidence vocabulary and engineering-flow expedite control already preserve the complete useful intent without universal WIP, expedite or automatic stop percentages.
items.protected_outcome: Fast bounded response without waiver of protected obligations or false approval
items.verification_reference: adaptive harness, engineering-flow and process-strength baseline tests
items.follow_up_trigger: A measured expedite failure or missing decision right is evidenced

items.intent: Classify scope changes, contain urgent disputes and preserve commercial evidence
items.rationale: Implemented a source-backed change and exception record. Universal rush fees, invoice thresholds, automatic tax transfers and generic legal-entitlement claims were removed because they depend on contract, jurisdiction and authority.
items.protected_outcome: Traceable commercial decisions without invented contractual or legal rights
items.follow_up_trigger: The controlled change-record contract or decision rights change

items.source_item: Requirement ambiguity, example mapping and keyword linter
items.intent: Expose unclear requirements before implementation or commercial dispute
items.rationale: Validation questions, examples and UNCLEAR classification are retained in creative exploration and commercial change control. The keyword linter is not adopted as a rejection gate because words such as modern or flexible are context signals, not proof of an invalid requirement.
items.protected_outcome: Clarification based on acceptance evidence rather than lexical false positives
items.follow_up_trigger: Representative escaped ambiguity shows a missing structured check

items.intent: Detect interface drift and prove candidate delivery completeness
items.rationale: The controlled software release evidence profile already requires candidate hashes, fixtures, workflow evidence, rollback and independent review. AST equality alone cannot prove behavioural compatibility, and a computed bundle hash cannot notarise or approve a handover.
items.protected_outcome: Candidate-specific release evidence without false compatibility or approval claims
items.follow_up_trigger: A named interface type needs an additional representative compatibility validator

items.source_item: CAD-to-cost policy, embedded rate card and calculator
items.intent: Connect geometry quantities, explicit allowances and cost-plan sanity checks
items.rationale: The capability is retained by the built-environment COST_PLAN contract, but the submitted embedded DIN 276 categories, Serbian prices, exchange rate and geometry corridors cannot be admitted generically. Activation requires a project-owned adapter with dated quantities, taxonomy, price sources, tax, uncertainty and qualified review.
items.protected_outcome: Traceable cost planning without stale prices, greenfield assumptions or false professional assurance
items.follow_up_trigger: An external project supplies approved geometry, cost taxonomy, dated rate sources, uncertainty and reviewer fixtures

items.source_item: Enterprise resilience, critical-chain buffer and FMEA calculator
items.intent: Protect constrained flow, recovery and risk response
items.rationale: Triton uses measured WIP, buffer and recovery evidence through engineering-flow and dependency-resilience controls. Universal slack, contingency and FMEA thresholds are omitted; project-specific buffer or FMEA calculations remain in the owning workspace and domain profile.
items.protected_outcome: Evidence-based resilience without universal reserve formulas or mixed risk scales
items.follow_up_trigger: A project declares an approved scheduling or risk-analysis method and fixtures

items.source_item: Operator psychology, resilience engine and interactive timer
items.intent: Help a person continue safely during low energy or overload
items.rationale: User-initiated low-energy support is now explicit: one reversible next step, fewer choices and a right to stop. Diagnosis, invented neuroscience rates, fixed daily caps, streak pressure, monetary reward accounting and silent quality reduction are rejected as coercive or unsupported.
items.protected_outcome: Supportive human control without surveillance, diagnosis or manipulative incentives
items.follow_up_trigger: User feedback identifies an accessibility or workload-support gap

items.source_item: Unified task, plan/build and make-or-buy engines
items.intent: Choose plan/build/delegate/source options and stop uneconomic persistence
items.rationale: Task Investment and Sourcing already compares protected obligations, readiness, dependencies, MAKE/BUY/HYBRID lifecycle TCO, option value and human decision. Aversion, joy and fixed 1.5x time rules cannot automatically assign work or override safety, labour, procurement and competence boundaries.
items.protected_outcome: Comparable sourcing decisions without personality scoring or universal circuit breakers
items.follow_up_trigger: A sourcing decision class is not expressible in the current controlled record

items.intent: Convert accepted lessons into reusable prevention controls
items.rationale: Triton preserves incident evidence in the product workspace and exports sanitised, reviewed lessons through the controlled learning interface. Automatic creation of normative RAG rules from one incident is rejected because root cause, generality, domain applicability and authority are not established.
items.protected_outcome: Reusable learning without contaminating controlled knowledge or inventing universal thresholds
items.follow_up_trigger: Independently accepted cross-project evidence supports a controlled prevention-rule proposal

items.source_item: ADKAR guide, operational playbook, manifesto and role cross-references
items.intent: Provide a coherent operating and change-adoption narrative across roles
items.rationale: The Human AI Company Academy, operating runbook, canonical role prompts, adaptive harness and source mapping already cover the effective content. Adding broad cross-references to every role increases prompt coupling without adding an independent responsibility or runtime capability.
items.protected_outcome: Coherent learning and execution without duplicate manuals or role-prompt bloat
items.verification_reference: role loader, registry, identity and communication-signature tests
items.follow_up_trigger: A measured training or handoff gap is not covered by the current Academy and runbook

items.source_item: Corporate finance, engineering economy and private wealth package
items.intent: Compare corporate investments and review realised outcomes
items.rationale: Corporate NPV comparison and realised-outcome variance are implemented with sourced cash flows, a declared discount rate and no automatic action. The universal 12 percent MARR, automatic shutdown and private 20/30/50 wealth allocation are excluded because they require approved corporate policy or qualified personal advice and current evidence.
items.protected_outcome: Transparent capital decision support without automatic investment action or personal financial advice
items.follow_up_trigger: The approved corporate hurdle-rate policy or capital decision record changes

items.source_item: Dynamic tool and MCP routing matrix
items.intent: Select the minimum sufficient tool and preserve an effective fallback
items.rationale: Implemented routing from explicit capabilities, admission status, data class, mode, cost, latency and evidence. Keyword routing to invented tools and silent browser fallback are rejected; fallback must independently satisfy the same boundary and requires an explicit failure decision.
items.protected_outcome: Efficient tool choice without bypassing admission, permissions or data boundaries
items.follow_up_trigger: A tool is admitted, restricted or retired in the controlled catalog

items.source_item: TSDE creativity policy, selector and unit tests
items.intent: Combine human creative anchors, divergent options and multi-objective convergence
items.rationale: Implemented optional creative lenses, explicit RULE_BOUND and EXPLORATORY modes, hard constraints, genuine non-dominance and a human decision boundary. Weighted top-three ranking, inferred unconscious needs and mandatory aesthetics are rejected.
items.protected_outcome: Creative breadth with truthful mathematics, provenance and human choice
items.follow_up_trigger: A controlled technique catalog or new objective type is proposed

items.source_item: Cross-engine system integration and reliability stress suite
items.intent: Prove useful cross-component behaviour and expose integration failures
items.rationale: Implemented one hermetic option-to-dashboard acceptance path with a failed hard constraint, escaped-input check, temporary state and deterministic cleanup. The submitted happy-path chain is not accepted as high-load or concurrency evidence.
items.protected_outcome: Integration evidence proportional to the exercised property
items.follow_up_trigger: A named interface or failure model requires an additional hermetic test

items.source_item: Dashboard suite, finance and creativity widgets, hover explanations and builder
items.intent: Provide understandable, reusable visual decision support
items.rationale: Implemented an accessible renderer with formula/evidence details, escaping, no remote asset and mandatory source, as-of, owner, population, confidence and data-quality state. Hard-coded live values, compliance labels, exchange rates and project claims remain demonstration-only.
items.protected_outcome: Useful dashboards without fabricated operational state or inaccessible hover-only explanations
items.follow_up_trigger: A controlled live KPI data contract is approved

items.source_item: Session-only dual execution model, staged hardening and KPI creativity throttling
items.intent: Use deterministic contracts for exact work and bounded creativity for exploration, then reduce variance when quality deteriorates
items.rationale: RULE_BOUND and EXPLORATORY modes plus evidence-based hardening are now controlled. Quality signals may propose a narrower template or containment but never mutate the active route automatically. No universal zero-defect, 100-percent reproducibility or unnamed eight-heuristic claim is adopted.
items.protected_outcome: Appropriate creativity with stable quality and accountable routing
items.follow_up_trigger: The exact eight heuristics and WKW method are supplied with source identity and intended use
